caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with an elongated, rounded body and a short, narrow neck ending in a small rim. The jug has a single handle that connects the neck to the upper part of the body on the right side. The surface of the jug is predominantly olive green with darker green and brown wavy vertical lines and spots covering its exterior, creating an irregular, organic pattern. The jug is centrally placed on a neutral, off-white background with a thin, rectangular border framing it. There is a signature "Annie B. Johnston" at the bottom right of the frame, along with the number "26" written in red in the lower right corner outside the border.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
